title: It's ok, not great...
text: It's ok, not great.... So I just received this is the mail yesterday and was really excited, Jack White is my favorite artist regardless of what band he's with or solo and I've been a White Stripes fan for almost 10 years now. For the price of this compared to other prints listed on Amazon, its a pretty good deal, but you can tell it's not official merchandise but more of something that somebody printed off themselves. Now it doesnt say anywhere that it is like licensed merchandise or anything, but still was hoping for slightly better quality, theres just something a little "off" about the ink, like it's really shiny in spots, But I guess for the price I really cant complain too much.
